response.original_title: 《!!~FAQs-Update》How can I add a room or cabin to Princess C
response.overview: To add another room to an existing Princess Cruise +1-888-315-9585 reservation, you must book a separate new stateroom and call Princess Cruise customer service at ++1-888-315-9585(US) or contact your travel agent to link the two bookings. Book a separate cabin: You cannot add a room to an existing reservation through the online website or mobile app. Book a new stateroom online or via phone. Contact Princess Cruise at ++1-888-315-9585(US) or your travel agent. You cannot directly add a new physical stateroom to an existing reservation online; instead, you must book a separate room and have it linked by calling Princess Cruise customer service at +44-808-196-9697
